display.purpose: Page title, e.g. the week range. Steps down to Title on phones.

title.purpose: Page titles on phones and section heads.

headline.purpose: Card titles, the wordmark, day numbers in the grid header.

body.purpose: Default copy, buttons, nav rows, inputs, menu items.

footnote.purpose: Supporting lines, field labels, segmented options, task-card titles in the column.

caption.purpose: Grid events and task blocks, hour labels, duration chips, badges, tab labels. The floor: nothing smaller.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Calendar, result card, task cards and blocks, selected segment. The 1px ring is the card's edge.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, sheets, toasts, a block being dragged.

shadows.name: run-ring
shadows.purpose: Cards a run placed or moved (about 4 s) and the task picked in the open-tasks column.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Instant feedback on every pressable. Reduced motion: opacity 0.7 instead.

motion.name: run-arrive
motion.value: 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); translateY(6px) and opacity 0.4 to rest; 50ms stagger per day
motion.purpose: The one arrival per run. Removed under reduced motion; the ring stays.

motion.name: skeleton
motion.purpose: Loading placeholders. Static under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Content gutter 16px to 24px; sheets centre instead of docking to the bottom.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Sidebar replaces the phone top bar and tab bar; week grid replaces the single-day view.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Calm Planner"**

Routinely sits in the category Sunsama and Motion define, and it meets that category at their craft level rather than inventing a metaphor of its own. A light, airy product UI: a cool near-white canvas, white surfaces lifted by soft two-layer shadows, 8 to 12 px corners, and a single indigo accent. The week has to read at a glance, so the grid recedes (hairlines, quiet hour labels) and the content carries the colour: commitments as soft tinted events in their own colour, tasks as white cards with a check circle.

Familiarity is the point. Nothing is decorative; every coloured pixel means something (a commitment's colour, the one action, the current selection, now). The AI's work is made visible through structure, not ornament: a result card that states what changed, and an indigo ring that holds on the cards a run just placed or moved. The dark theme is the same structure on graphite surfaces, a token swap rather than a second design.

Scope, recorded honestly: the shell (sidebar, phone top bar and tab bar) and the week screen were redesigned for this world. Tarefas, Compromissos, Histórico, Ajustes, the sheets and the auth screens inherit the tokens and primitives below but have not yet been composed against this direction. The previous "Mapa do metrô" transit world was rejected by the user and is fully replaced; nothing of it is part of this system.
keyCharacteristics: Light by default, with dark and system themes chosen in the app.
One indigo accent; every other hue belongs to a commitment.
White cards on a near-white canvas, separated by soft shadow plus a 1px ring, not by heavy borders.
Inter for everything, tabular numerals for every time and count.
Every control is at least 44px tall; nothing is smaller than 12px.
Calm motion: instant press feedback, one arrival per run, nothing moves under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo means "act here, you are here, or this just changed": the primary action, focus, selection, today, and the run ring. It is never a commitment colour in disguise and never decoration.

rules.name: The Tint, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: On the grid, a commitment's colour is a tint of the surface (13% in light, 16% in dark) with text in its ink (62% / 82% of the tone mixed into the label colour). Solid tone fills are reserved for dots and small markers.

rules.name: The Word, Not Colour Rule
rules.body: Urgency is a word ("Urgente" in danger red, "Alta" in secondary text), never a card colour. A task card is always white.

rules.name: The Caption Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the UI is smaller than Caption (12px). Short grid cards drop lines, not type size.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every time, range, count and duration uses tabular numerals so columns of times align.

rules.name: The Ring, Not Border Rule
rules.body: A card's edge is the 1px ring inside its shadow, never a separate border. Borders are for dividers inside a card (`hairline`) and for control outlines (`separator`).

rules.name: The Run Ring
rules.body: The cards a run placed or moved arrive with a short rise (6px, from 40% opacity, 360ms, `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, staggered 50ms per day) and then hold a 2px indigo ring outside a 2px surface gap for about four seconds. Kept blocks never move. Under reduced motion only the ring remains.

dos: Do reference semantic tokens (`canvas`, `surface`, `label`, `accent`, `--tone`) and never raw hex, so light and dark stay a token swap.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44px and every text at least 12px.
Do give commitments their tone as a tint on the grid and as a dot on their tasks.
Do use the two-layer Card shadow to separate white surfaces from the canvas.
Do use tabular numerals for times, counts and durations.
Do keep motion to instant press feedback (100 to 200ms) and one arrival per run, and remove movement under reduced motion.
Do apply the saved theme before first paint (`data-theme` on `<html>`, choice in `localStorage` key `routinely:theme`, absent means system).
donts: Don't introduce a second accent or use indigo for anything but action, focus, selection, today and the run ring.
Don't fill task cards with a colour; urgency is a word.
Don't fill events with a solid tone or give them a shadow.
Don't draw borders around cards; the shadow ring is the edge.
Don't copy Sunsama's or Motion's logos, names, illustrations or exact brand colours; the category standard is the reference, not their assets.
